pat_cs: FYI Epsilon Health (eps123) showing rising token spend and p95 jitter over last 3 weeks. Renewal in ~2 months. Can we propose a low-risk perf playbook to share with customer and ops?

leo_eng: Thanks Pat. Quick snapshot we pulled: avg seq 185, p95 ~820ms, 99th ~2.4s, token cost +21% WoW on chat route. Lots of repeated system prompts from reconnect flows.

sam_ops: My gut: short-term wins = prompt/KV caching + small-model fast path for <600 token requests, medium-term = int8 canary on non-sensitive routes.

anya_se: +1. Suggest we package as: immediate TTL cache, routing rule by token_count threshold, and a 72h canary to validate quality. Minimal infra change.

rachel_product: For renewal narrative we need: expected cost delta, p95 improvement estimate, QA checklist, and a one-paragraph customer message template.

leo_eng: Proposed canary snippet (example):
```
canary:
  name: eps-int8-72h
  pct: 5
  model: rwd-open-6.7b-int8
  fallback: rwd-open-6.7b-fp16
  monitor: [latency_p95, top10_intent_acceptance, token_delta]
  duration: 72h
```

sam_ops: For routing rule idea:
`if request.tokens <= 600 => route: rwd-open-3b-fast`
`else if 600 < request.tokens <= 1400 => route: rwd-open-6.7b-int8-canary`
`else => route: rwd-open-6.7b-fp16`
Keep it per-customer override under eps123.

anya_se: Also recommend prompt-cache TTL 20s for system prompts and 150ms prewarm KV before 11:45am PST spike. That should cut duplicate tokens on reconnects.

deploybot: deployment-bot: Ticket #RWD-4928 created for eps123 canary + routing override. CI pipeline triggered.

pat_cs: Action items: leo run the 72h canary eval with top-8 intents and upload artifacts (+4 days); sam create console route override + infra PR (+3 days); anya add cache TTL & prewarm config (+2 days); rachel draft renewal slide + customer note (+6 days).

rachel_product: I'll draft the customer note: short, non-technical, emphasize "no interruption" and expected cost savings estimate.

leo_eng: For evaluation metrics I'll capture: intent_accept_rate, hallucination_flag_rate, mean_latency, p95_latency, token_consumption_per_session.

sam_ops: I'll provision a short-lived dedicated pool for peak hours if canary shows regressions — keeps customer SLAs safe.

pat_cs: Great. Let's keep this thread for updates and paste any config/graphs here. :white_check_mark:
